standaloneRustConsumer: passed with the romedb-production profile; 344 registry/git package identities match the workspace lockfile
upgradeRestore: Passed from the 0.2.13 to 0.2.22 packages on Node 22.0.0 and 24.19.0 (groups v0213-upgrade-restore to v0222-upgrade-restore). 0.2.13 is the floor: it changed the stored value prefix, and earlier files are refused. A collection with a full-text index that declares filter paths uses catalog version 11, which 0.2.22 and earlier refuse.

engine.exceptions: the maintained engine exceptions retained, two added: FTS filter columns and FTS typo words (romedb/docs/core-exceptions.md)
engine.storageFormat: __romedb_ schema prefix, .romedb extension, stored values prefixed RDB 01 (FDB 01 before 0.2.13); openEmbedded and serve use MVCC files; collections with a * array path index use catalog version 8, others keep version 7 or earlier; collections with a weighted full-text index use catalog version 9; collections with a folded or stemmed full-text index use catalog version 10; collections with a full-text index that declares filter paths use catalog version 11
engine.change: two engine core patches in core/index_method/fts: the filters WITH key indexes filter columns whole with the raw tokenizer, outside the default query fields, and a column:value or column: IN [...] term on one matches with score 0; word~1 and word~2 match the word and the 64 most common indexed words within that many edits, the other words at half weight. search::count is a frontend source; the raised request limits and the result limits header are frontend, service and client changes. rustix 1.1.6 for RUSTSEC-2026-0486. Same upstream as 0.2.22 (Turso v0.8.3, Tantivy 0.27.0)

spatial.explainReadsNoData: metered EXPLAIN reports zero rows read for every spatial form (spatial_explain_reads_no_documents_or_index_entries)

supportedScope.ownership: One owning process per database file; shared clients connect to its service

resolvedForRelease: RUSTSEC-2026-0486 (rustix before 1.1.6 marks bytes that were never written as initialized in its extended-attribute functions when given a zero-length buffer): rustix 1.1.6 with linux-raw-sys 0.12.1

documentationOverrides.ENVELOPE.md: Historical 2.1.0 measurements; the raw-evidence link points to the immutable fastdb-v2.1.0 release

performance: Historical 2.1.0 operating envelope retained; fresh bounded application sample, not capacity guarantees
buildHost: Built and qualified under scripts/romedb-heavy (shared lock, two jobs, cgroup memory ceiling)
publication: Qualified for publication; anonymous public-download verification is separate
